meta.description: Nova Assist takes over your customer relations — calls, WhatsApp, emails, sales follow-up — with the responsiveness and confidentiality of a dedicated team, without the cost of hiring in-house.

accueil.intro: Calls, WhatsApp, emails, sales follow-up: Nova Assist takes over your customer relations with the responsiveness and confidentiality of a dedicated team, without the cost of hiring in-house.
accueil.photoLegende: Professional wearing a headset, bright office, looking into the lens

offres.intro: Three monthly levels of support, with no long-term commitment. Volume and channels can be adjusted at any time.
offres.tarifsIndicatifs: Indicative prices, to be confirmed — online payment via Tara from the client area.

confiance.titre: A local team with the rigour of an international provider
confiance.photoLegende: Hands on a keyboard, plain close-up — or a view of a tidy desk
confiance.confidentialiteTexte: A non-disclosure agreement is signed before any assignment; access is limited and traceable.
confiance.reactiviteTexte: Every request is time-stamped. You get the actual response time, not a promise.
confiance.ancrageTexte: Same time zone, same habits, WhatsApp first. Your clients talk to someone who understands them.

cta.titre: Tell us what is eating your time.
cta.texte: An answer within 24 working hours, free quote, no commitment.

services.eyebrow: What we take off your hands

01.resume: Inbound calls, WhatsApp Business and emails handled in your name, using your standard replies.
01.detail: Inbound calls, WhatsApp Business and emails handled in your name, using your standard replies and your tone.

02.resume: Calendar kept up to date, client reminders, fewer missed appointments.
02.detail: Calendar kept up to date, reminders sent the day before, a clear drop in missed appointments.

03.resume: Follow-up on unpaid invoices, due-date tracking, weekly reporting.
03.detail: Follow-up on unpaid invoices on an agreed schedule, due-date tracking and reporting.

04.resume: Data entry, quotes, invoices, document filing and inbox management.
04.detail: Data entry, quotes, invoices, document filing and day-to-day inbox management.

05.resume: Posts, replies to messages and comments, monitoring of your pages.
05.detail: Scheduled posts, replies to messages and comments, monitoring of your pages.

06.resume: Lead qualification, follow-up on quotes sent, no opportunity left behind.
06.detail: Lead qualification and follow-up on quotes sent: no opportunity lost for lack of a reminder.
